title: Request a Workshop — Badger Supports
description: Badger Supports workshops help groups build connection and individuals gain practical tools for everyday challenges. Led by trained student Peer Facilitators.

blocks.title: Request a Workshop
blocks.lead: Badger Supports workshops help groups build connection and individuals gain practical tools for everyday challenges. Led by trained student Peer Facilitators, each session includes interactive activities and open discussion. If your group has specific goals or needs, please share them when requesting—we’re happy to adjust the content or format.

blocks.title: Building Support Networks
body: Strengthen the support systems within your group and beyond

items.text: Identify and grow your personal and group support systems
Build a culture of care, trust, and connection
Practice reaching out and showing up for one another

blocks.title: Stress Management & Self Care
body: Support your group’s well-being by building shared tools and habits

items.text: Understand stress and burnout and how they show up across your group
Learn realistic self-care strategies and practical ways to build healthy habits
Build group norms that respect boundaries and avoid burnout

blocks.title: Self Advocacy
body: Empower your group members to speak up and support one another

items.text: Practice self advocacy skills that improve communication and confidence
Know your rights and how to advocate for them
Strengthen your group’s ability to navigate challenges together
Feel equipped to explore housing options, compare locations, and make informed choices
Get comfortable asking landlords and property managers the questions that matter
Learn the essentials of tenant rights so you can advocate when something doesn’t feel right
Build teamwork skills that help with shared decisions, budgets, and healthy roommate dynamics

blocks.title: Volunteer Training
body: Build peer support skills, including active listening, follow-up questions, and actionable resource referrals.
Learn how to support friends and peers!

a: Request a workshop via our workshop request form.
For additional inquiries please email directors@badgersupports.org

items.a: Available to Registered Student Organizations, residence halls, classrooms, individual students, groups of students, and campus departments that primarily serve student audiences.

blocks.title: Testimonials & Feedback
blocks.body: Badger Supports is always looking to grow and improve. If you have feedback, suggestions, or a story to share, we’d love to hear from you. Please take a moment to fill out our feedback form.

blocks.title: Accommodation Requests
body: Badger Supports values inclusion and access for all participants and is pleased to provide reasonable accommodations for any Badger Supports workshop. Please contact accessibility@badgersupports.org to make a reasonable accommodation request. Requests must be submitted 5 days prior to the workshop.
